eQ.text:
Project Controller v4.0 by FinitePlane


Launching and Terminating Projects:

"Project - will start" -- receive-only message:
    Broadcasted after the cover fades out and before the project fades in.
    Initialize and setup your project here.
    IMPORTANT:
         Do not attach runtime or animation loops here. Use the "Project - launch" message instead.

"Project - start" -- receive-only message:
    Broadcasted after broadcasting "Project - will start" and before the project fades in.
    Start any runtime loops or animations here.

"Project - did start" -- receive-only message:
    Broadcasted after the project fades in.

"Project - will stop" -- receive-only message:
    Broadcasted after the stop sign is clicked.
    Run any code needed to terminate the project here.

"Project - is running?" -- read-only boolean variable:
    Is 1 when the project is running and 0 when the project is stopped.

"Project - reset" -- message:
    Broadcasted when the stop sign is clicked while the "x" key is pressed.

"Project - restart" -- message:
    Broadcast this to restart the project.


Reading Time:

"timer" -- number variable:
    The time since the project was launched in seconds.
    Set to "0" to reset the timer.
    This timer is more accurate than the built-in timer.
    
"delta time" -- read-only number variable:
    The time since the previous frame in seconds.
    This value is restricted to a maximum of 0.05 seconds (or a minimum of 20 fps).

"current time" -- read-only number variable:
    The number of seconds since the year 2000.
    This value is not effected by the start, stop, or pause (in TurboWarp or web extensions) buttons.


Handling User Interface Styles:

"UI Style - update" -- receive-only message:
    Change the color scheme of your sprites to match the "UI Style - is dark?" variable.
    Can be broadcasted by external code.

"UI Style - is dark?" -- boolean variable:
    Is 1 if true and 0 if false.
    To override this value, first set the "UI Style - override?" variable to 1. Then broadcast "UI Style - update".

"UI Style - override?" -- boolean variable:
    Set to 1 if you want to override the "UI Style - is dark?" variable.


Responding to Mouse and Key Presses:

"any key was pressed?" -- read-only boolean variable:
    Is set to "0" when no keys were pressed on the last frame and is set to "1" when any key was pressed on the last frame.
    Note:
        You can use:
            <<(any key was pressed?) = (0)> and <key () pressed?>>
        in a run loop message to prevent continuous looping when a key is pressed.

"mouse was down?" -- read-only boolean variable:
    Is set to "0" when the mouse was up on last frame and is set to "1" when the mouse was down on the last frame.
    Note:
        You can use:
            <<(mouse was down?) = (0)> and <mouse down?>>
        in a run loop message to detect the beginning of a mouse click.


Enabling Visual Statistics for Debugging:

"fps" -- read-only number variable:
    The approximate number of frames in a second.


Reading Stage Dimensions:

"Stage - fill size" -- read-only variable:
    The size to make a 480x360 sprite fill the stage.
    This value is a percentage.

"Stage - fit size" -- read-only variable:
    The size to make a 480x360 sprite fit inside the stage.
    This value is a percentage.

"Stage - width" -- read-only variable:
    The width of the stage.

"Stage - height" -- read-only variable:
    The height of the stage.

"Stage - max x" -- read-only variable:
    The maximum x position inside the stage.

"Stage - min x" -- read-only variable:
    The minimum x position inside the stage.

EG.text:
UI Animator v1.4 by ThinkingPlanely

Needed Sprites:
- Animator PU

Starting an Animation:

"Animator - views to dismiss" -- text list:
    The views that will be dismissed.

"Animator - views to present" -- text list:
    The views that will be presented.

"animate views for (seconds) secs" -- custom block:
    Starts presenting the views added to "Animator - views to present" and dismissing the views added to "Animator - views to dismiss".

"transition to views for (seconds) secs" -- custom block:
    Starts dismissing the presented views and presenting the views added to "Animator - views to present".


Handling Presentation:

"[name] - will appear" -- message protocol:
    Sets up the view for its presentation.

"[name] - update presentation" -- message protocol:
    This updates the view for every frame during the presentation animation.
    Read from any of the progress variables to update your view.

"[name] - did appear" -- message protocol:
    Broadcasted after the view is presented.


Handling Dismissal:

"[name] - will disappear" -- message protocol:
    Sets up the view for dismissal.

"[name] - update dismissal" -- message protocol:
    This updates the view for every frame during the dismissal animation.
    Read from any of the progress variables to update your view.

"[name] - did disappear" -- message protocol:
    Runs any code needed to complete the view's dismissal (e.g. hiding sprites).


Getting the Animation Progress:

"Animator - progress - linear" -- variable:
    The linear progression of an animation, starting at 0.0 and ending at 1.0.

"Animator - progress - ease in" -- variable:
    The progression of an animation easing in, starting at 0 and ending at 1.0.

"Animator - progress - ease out" -- variable:
    The progression of an animation easing out, starting at 0 and ending at 1.0.

"Animator - progress - ease in out" -- variable:
    The progression of an animation easing in and out, starting at 0 and ending at 1.0.
